svg.text: From an analyst's direction to tested features — and proof they change the cases that matter.
the cases the analyst cares about

g.text: engines propose ideas; the agent turns
L3 · ask for data we don't have yet
retrain on full splits; test on
kept only if the gain holds
every result is logged — pass or fail
each result raises or lowers its idea's odds of being drawn next
every target case, base vs new

svg.text: target cases go straight to inference
the analyst investigates the output further and sets the next direction

g.text: fix and retry until it runs, then check and screen
all results re-rank the ideas and sharpen generation
pulled data becomes a new source to build from
findings inspire the analyst's next direction
Example rows, scores and counts are illustrative.
